Clean Code Development and working experience with Unit Testing, and Test-driven Development. Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team. Fluency in English (spoken and written). Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to adjust quickly to changing assignments, and priorities. Experience working with and contributing to UX designs. Hands‑on experience designing and operating event‑driven systems using Event Sourcing and CQRS. Experience with React, Next.js, GraphQL, and TypeScript. Working experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM templates. Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery. Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans. Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns.
